newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Sept 27.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Sept 27.

text.p: -- PepsiCo Inc said late Thursday it plans to restructure its international operations and take special charges that will cause its third quarter earnings to fall short of year-earlier results.
Pepsi rose 1/8 to 30-1/4 on Thursday and surged 1-1/4 to 31-1/2 in after-hours trading.
-- A.H. Belo Corp agreed to buy Providence Journal Co for $1.5 billion in cash and stock, forming one of the largest U.S. media companies with interests in publishing and broadcasting.
-- ValuJet plans to resume flights on Monday. It closed at 12-14/16.
-- FoxMeyer Health is in talks aimed at selling its drug distribution unit to McKesson, the Wall Street Journal reported. Foxmeyer closed at 3-1/2.
-- Mackie Designs expects disappointing third quarter earnings. It closed at 9-1/2.
-- Aztar Corp said it expects a loss in the third quarter after pre-opening expenses related to its Atlantic City property expansion. Aztar closed at 9-7/8.
